name: Bible Reader
description: Native, fully offline PS5 Bible reader by YAHBALLON. Includes all 66 books and five complete public-domain Bible translations (English, German, French, Spanish and Russian), fully translated menus, daily verse, chapter navigation, search, bookmarks, persistent reading position and customizable font/theme. On-device Piper Neural HD text-to-speech reads continuously from the selected verse with yellow karaoke-style word highlighting, backed by offline eSpeak NG.
author: YAHBALLON
